verdict.rationale: The official Claude Agent SDK, programmable in Python and TypeScript, can control which skills sessions invoke, discover filesystem-authored skills, and load plugins and other Claude Code features programmatically (docs-84, docs-63, docs-64, docs-77, docs-78). On the API side, skills are passed via the Messages API `container` parameter (up to 20 per request) and managed through a Skills API with version management (docs-10, docs-23, docs-24, docs-72). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the official SDKs (the runtime probe used third-party `npx skills` tooling, not an official SDK), and explicit evidence of client-library (non-REST) bindings for the Skills upload/version API.
